{{Quote|With a few thousand of the Republic's finest embarked, Thirty-fifth Infantry and Tenth Armored. Just to soften up Eyat and a few other major cities to allow the Marits to move in, then pull out when the dust has settled.|Sergeant A'den|<ref name="RC:TC" />}}
The '''Tenth Armored''' was a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="RC:TC" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]</ref> the unit saw [[Battle of Gaftikar|action]] when they were brought to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]] aboard the ''[[Leveler]]'' and deployed alongside the [[35th Infantry]]. With the two units' combined forces reaching a few thousand, the units were sent to weaken the some of the planet's major [[City/Legends|cities]] that were controlled by the Separatist-aligned [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. After the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces attacked the cities, the Republic-aligned [[Marit]]s were left to take control.<ref name="RC:TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tenth Armored was mentioned in the [[2007]] novel, ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', the third novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:TC" />
